fig3_knn.radius: q-quantile of 10^6 random pair distances of the whole standardized data set (same for all n)
fig3_knn.subsets: trial s uses the first n points of permutation s of the whole data set (nested in n)

fig4_scaling.radius: q-quantile of 10^6 random pair distances of the whole standardized data set (same for all n)
fig4_scaling.subsets: the first n points of one random permutation (nested in n)
fig4_scaling.timing: Single thread (OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads = 1) on one computer (Intel Core i7-14700, Windows 11). Each condition was timed in three separate processes, each pinned to one logical processor of a performance core with Windows power throttling disabled and with the default floating-point mode (subnormal numbers not flushed); each process timed three runs after a warm-up. Reported: the median over the processes of the per-process medians; the minimum and maximum over the processes. One initialization per method and condition.
fig4_scaling.peak_memory: tracemalloc peak of one more run per condition in a separate process

fig4_memberships.subsets: first n points of permutation 10000 (as the timing run)
fig4_memberships.radius: q-quantile of 10^6 random pair distances of the whole data set (as the timing run)

fig5_stream.radius: q-quantile of the distances of all pairs of the subset
fig5_stream.timing: Time per input: Single thread (OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads = 1) on one computer (Intel Core i7-14700, Windows 11). Each stream was timed in three separate processes, each pinned to one logical processor of a performance core with Windows power throttling disabled and with the default floating-point mode (subnormal numbers not flushed); each process timed three runs after a warm-up.
